semantics: keep P iff cross(B-A, P-A) >= 0 for keep 'left' (<= 0 for 'right'); line = [A, B] in CRS metres; points on the line are kept. Raster cells are tested at their centres; features at their vertices (06, 11), footprint envelope centre (07) or node (10).
wkt_note: The KEPT region: the site's tile-grid rectangle cut by the half-plane, in CRS metres. Machine-readable form of `line` + `keep`; null if the grid keeps nothing.
